name: Generate a phone or desktop wallpaper from a prompt or your photo
tagline: Describe a scene, or upload a picture, and download an original wallpaper
description: Wallpaper Maker AI is an online wallpaper generator for phones and desktops. Describe a scene in words or upload a photo, choose an image model and the size, and download an original wallpaper a few seconds later. New accounts get 20 free credits with no card (a text wallpaper costs 2 credits, a photo wallpaper 4). A Starter plan is $9/month for 100 credits, and a one-time credit pack is also offered.
